checks.claim: The per-trajectory recurrence is unrolled backwards along the trajectory, and the source comment states the purpose is bootstrapping.
checks.evidence: # Unroll the per-trajectory RNN core in reverse direction for bootstrapping.

checks.claim: pi, y and z are all trained with categorical KL divergence: the predictions are distributions over bins, not scalars.
The meta-network receives (y_t, y_t+1) pairs and both the policy-weighted average and the max over actions of z at t and t+1 -- the sufficient statistics of a local balance condition.
No backward policy and no parent-set information is ever fed to the meta-network; the only non-forward signal is the reverse recurrence over the realised trajectory suffix.
Two recurrences exist -- backward within a trajectory and forward across the agent's lifetime -- and they are combined multiplicatively.
